## gate-exchange-affiliate 1.0.1

- Updated branding and MCP references; clarified dependency on Gate MCP server and tools.
- Added support for affiliate/partner application eligibility and application status checks.
- Clarified time range handling (UTC+8) and enforced a 180-day query maximum split into 30-day API segments.
- Improved API field and `user_id` parameter usage guidance to prevent misuse.
- Added stricter security and aggregation rules for safer and more accurate data handling.
- Refreshed documentation (README, SKILL.md, quick-start, scenarios) for clarity and alignment with latest API/business requirements.

gate-exchange-affiliate v1.0.0

- Initial release providing access to Gate Exchange's affiliate/partner program data.
- Supports commission, trading volume, net fees, customer count, and trading user queries for up to 180 days (30-day segments via API).
- Enforces strict time handling (UTC+8, no future timestamps) and partner-only API usage.
- Implements custom data aggregation logic (no simple summing) to match business rules.
- Guides users in applying for the affiliate program and clarifies critical API parameter usage (especially `user_id`).
